actions.name: sunlight sensitivity
actions.desc: While in sunlight, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks, using [[/item .mmNecroticSword0]] or [[/item .mmNecroticBow000]] in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item .mmLifeDrain00000]].

actions.name: life drain
actions.desc: Life Drain. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]], one [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]] within [[lookup @range.value activity=FA4Mt9cXsYfHDDcs]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmZombie00000000]{Zombie} under the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.
